ThingDef.label: archotech minigun
ThingDef.description: A heavy, powerful gun made by a mysterious archotech. This weapon is capable of dealing massive, devastating damage to any kind of target with its rapid fire rate.

ThingDef.label: archotech shotgun
ThingDef.description: A powerful shotgun-like weapon crafted by a mysterious archotech. This weapon is capable of shooting powerful blasts that can obliterate anything within a relatively short distance.

ThingDef.label: archotech LMG
ThingDef.description: A heavy automatic weapon crafted by a mysterious archotech. This magnificent piece of advanced weapon engineering is capable of shooting powerful slugs at long range, which are extremely lethal and can easily pierce through even the best of armors.

ThingDef.label: archotech pistol
ThingDef.description: A small, yet advanced and powerful pistol crafted by a mysterious archotech. These pistols are very rarely seen wielded by mysterious or very powerful personalities, since they can deal heavy damage despite being so small.

ThingDef.label: archotech voidlauncher
ThingDef.description: A big, heavy and powerful piece of advanced weaponry crafted by a powerful and mysterious archotech. This extremely lethal weapon is capable of launching heavy devastating projectiles at long distances, which can completely destroy anything they collide with, leaving behind nothing but dust.

ThingDef.label: archotech crossbow
ThingDef.description: An ancient crossbow-like weapon crafted by a mysterious archotech. These weapons fire piercing arrows that can easily destroy armor and cut through flesh and bone as a sharp needle pierces through cloth.

ThingDef.label: archotech bow
ThingDef.description: A great bow-like weapon crafted by a mysterious archotech. These weapons shoot fast, large bolts that can pierce easily through armor and flesh. In the hands of a trained marksman, this weapon can become exceptionally lethal and dangerous.

ThingDef.label: archotech smg
ThingDef.description: A light, compact and powerful machine gun crafted by a mysterious archotech. This gun is a masterpiece of weapon engineering that can fire light, fast bullets which can deal heavy damage.

ThingDef.label: archotech sniper
ThingDef.description: A big, sophisticated and ultra-advanced weapon carefully designed and crafted by a powerful archotech mind. This weapon has extremely long range and can fire bolts that almost seem to have an intelligence of their own. When wielded by a trained sniper, this weapon can become the most destructive weapon to ever exist on an entire planet.

ThingDef.label: archotech rifle
ThingDef.description: A rifle-like weapon crafted by a mysterious archotech. This weapon fires bolts of concentrated void energy that can destroy almost any target.
